title: Trump Threatens Military Action Against Oman Over Hormuz Blockade
title_cn: 特朗普威胁就霍尔木兹封锁对阿曼采取军事行动
summary: In a recent statement to Fox News, President Donald Trump warned that the US would bomb Oman if it interferes with the US blockade in the Strait of Hormuz. Tyler Kendall reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Spurned Again by Supreme Court on $5 Million Carroll Award
title_cn: 最高法院再次驳回特朗普颁发的 500 万美元卡罗尔奖
summary: The US Supreme Court for a second time rejected President Donald Trump’s request to overturn a jury finding that he sexually abused and defamed the writer E. Jean Carroll.
